audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Wisdom, evildoers, land inheritance, wealth, violence, and patience.

verses.restored: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

familiar.text: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

modern.text: Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.

original.text: לְדָוִ֨ד אַל תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּעֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה

verses.restored: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

familiar.text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

modern.text: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.

original.text: כִּ֣י כֶ֭חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּכְיֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן

verses.restored: Trust in YHWH, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

familiar.text: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

modern.text: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.

original.text: בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭יהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה

verses.restored: Delight thyself also in YHWH: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

familiar.text: Delight thyself also in the LORD: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

modern.text: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.

original.text: וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל יְהוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Commit thy way to YHWH; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

familiar.text: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

modern.text: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.

original.text: גּ֣וֹל עַל יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה

verses.restored: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

familiar.text: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

modern.text: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.

original.text: וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Rest in YHWH, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

familiar.text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

modern.text: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.

original.text: דּ֤וֹם לַיהוָה֮ וְהִתְח֪וֹלֵ֫ל ל֥וֹ אַל תִּ֭תְחַר בְּמַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ בְּ֝אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת

verses.restored: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

familiar.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

modern.text: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.

original.text: הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭אַף וַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ לְהָרֵֽעַ

verses.restored: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon YHWH, they shall inherit the earth.

familiar.text: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

modern.text: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.

original.text: כִּֽי מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּן וְקֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ אָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

familiar.text: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

modern.text: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

original.text: וְע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְהִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל מְקוֹמ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: But the humble shall inherit the land and delight themselves in abundant peace.

familiar.text: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

notes.title: Inherit the land
notes.body: The Hebrew eretz can mean land or earth. This wisdom promise concerns the reversal of violent power; it is not a modern deed of territorial ownership or authorization for dispossession.

modern.text: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.

original.text: וַעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הִתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם

verses.restored: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

familiar.text: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

modern.text: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,

original.text: זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וְחֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו שִׁנָּֽיו

verses.restored: YHWH shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

familiar.text: The LORD shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

modern.text: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.

original.text: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִשְׂחַק ל֑וֹ כִּֽי רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽוֹ

verses.restored: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

familiar.text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

modern.text: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.

original.text: חֶ֤רֶב פָּֽתְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְדָרְכ֪וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥ם לְ֭הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי דָֽרֶךְ

verses.restored: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

familiar.text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

modern.text: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

original.text: חַ֭רְבָּם תָּב֣וֹא בְלִבָּ֑ם וְ֝קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה

verses.restored: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

familiar.text: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

modern.text: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.

original.text: טוֹב מְ֭עַט לַצַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים

verses.restored: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but YHWH upholdeth the righteous.

familiar.text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

modern.text: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

original.text: כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְסוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

familiar.text: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

modern.text: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.

original.text: יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝נַחֲלָתָ֗ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

familiar.text: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

modern.text: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.

original.text: לֹֽא יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ

verses.restored: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of YHWH shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

familiar.text: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

modern.text: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.

original.text: כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְאֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה כִּיקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶעָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ

verses.restored: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

familiar.text: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

modern.text: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.

original.text: לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן

verses.restored: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

familiar.text: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

modern.text: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.

original.text: כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָיו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝מְקֻלָּלָ֗יו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ

verses.restored: The steps of a good man are ordered by YHWH: and he delighteth in his way.

familiar.text: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.

modern.text: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.

original.text: מֵ֭יְהוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְדַרְכּ֥וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ

verses.restored: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for YHWH upholdeth him with his hand.

familiar.text: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.

modern.text: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.

original.text: כִּֽי יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי יְ֝הוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽוֹ

verses.restored: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

familiar.text: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

modern.text: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.

original.text: נַ֤עַר הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽלֹא רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ לָֽחֶם

verses.restored: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

familiar.text: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

modern.text: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.

original.text: כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ לִבְרָכָֽה

verses.restored: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

familiar.text: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

modern.text: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.

original.text: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה ט֗וֹב וּשְׁכֹ֥ן לְעוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: For YHWH loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

familiar.text: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

modern.text: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.

original.text: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֨ה אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת

verses.restored: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

familiar.text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

modern.text: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

original.text: צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

familiar.text: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

modern.text: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.

original.text: פִּֽי צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט

verses.restored: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

familiar.text: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

modern.text: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.

original.text: תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָיו

verses.restored: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

familiar.text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

modern.text: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,

original.text: צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ

verses.restored: YHWH will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

familiar.text: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

modern.text: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.

original.text: יְ֭הוָה לֹא יַעַזְבֶ֣נּוּ בְיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗נּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ

verses.restored: Wait on YHWH, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

familiar.text: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

modern.text: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

original.text: קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל יְהוָ֨ה וּשְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗וֹ וִֽ֭ירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה

verses.restored: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

familiar.text: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

modern.text: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,

original.text: רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּאֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן

verses.restored: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

familiar.text: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

modern.text: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.

original.text: וַ֭יַּֽעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֵינֶ֑נּוּ וָֽ֝אֲבַקְשֵׁ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָֽא

verses.restored: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

familiar.text: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

modern.text: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.

original.text: שְׁמָר תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם

verses.restored: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

familiar.text: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

modern.text: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.

original.text: וּֽ֭פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה

verses.restored: But the salvation of the righteous is of YHWH: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

familiar.text: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

modern.text: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.

original.text: וּתְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵיְהוָ֑ה מָֽ֝עוּזָּ֗ם בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָֽה

verses.restored: And YHWH shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

familiar.text: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

modern.text: The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.

original.text: וַֽיַּעְזְרֵ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיְפַ֫לְּטֵ֥ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם כִּי חָ֥סוּ בֽוֹ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Land promises are not modern property deeds; “wicked” must not become an ethnic or political category.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.

modern.edition: Current 3rd Printing; eBible source files dated June 2026
modern.provenance: eBible.org engbsb USFM distribution from BSB Publishing, LLC

original_hebrew.source: Westminster Leningrad Codex via Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible

original_greek.attribution: Society of Biblical Literature and Logos/Faithlife
